message.content: Starting triage on the reported wall penetration — shrinking to a minimal case.
Shrink isolated a fast body hitting a thin wall. I'll confirm the trace and inspect the impact.
Replay confirmed deterministic. Now inspecting states around the violation.
First violation at step 17 confirmed. Checking earlier steps to trace the approach.
Body is drifting into the wall across steps. Looking further back to find initial contact.
Penetration builds over steps 15–17. Checking when contact began.
Contact deepens despite substepping. Checking the initial state to complete the picture.
The horizontal velocity never responds to the wall — I'll test whether wall thickness is the trigger.
Thickness change didn't affect the identical trace — refining the corner-contact hypothesis and gathering earlier contact data.
Horizontal velocity never changes despite deepening wall overlap — testing a clean side-face hit as counterfactual.
Side-face hit bounces cleanly while corner grazes sink in — confirming the corner-contact cause before reporting.
